thread:
Priya: Heads-up: SCIM provisioning errors after last night's KMS alias swap. Customers seeing 502s and failed deprovisions.

Liam: Confirmed. CloudTrail shows Decrypt errors: IncorrectKeyMaterial around 02:04 UTC. Alias scim/envelope was remapped.

Sam: Provisioner log sample:
```
2024-05-02T02:04:12Z error="jwe unwrap: decrypt: IncorrectKeyMaterial"
```

Priya: Any RBAC denies?

Liam: No denies. This is key-type mismatch: alias now points at an RSA (SIGN) CMK instead of a SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT (ENCRYPT_DECRYPT) CMK.

Sam: Rollback alias to previous key to restore unwrap. Will that make already-wrapped tokens readable?

Priya: We only changed alias, no rewrap job ran. Rollback should restore decryptability for new operations.

ops-bot: rollback/PR-120 merged and applied.

Liam: Post-rollback metrics: Decrypt errors down, SCIM success rate normalizing.

Priya: Action items: 1) Block alias swaps that change KeySpec/KeyUsage. 2) Surface clearer errors with key id/alias in provisioner logs. 3) Add a 15m canary + manual sign-off for alias changes. 4) Add CI pre-rotate test that simulates an incompatible alias.

Sam: I'll update runbook and add the compatibility check in the deployment pipeline.

Priya: Drafting postmortem. Root cause: alias repointed to an incompatible key type; contributing factor: insufficient pre-rotate validation and delayed KMS audit visibility.

Sam: Recommend also logging the KMS key id with every JWE unwrap failure to speed triage.

Priya: Agreed. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
